description_en: Adds a program list to a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live add-caster-episode-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --item '[{"ItemName":"ItemName1","VodUrl":"http://learn.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea37348366201****.flv?auth_key=1608953344-0-0-53f0758162964516ac850f2ddc3f****"}]' --client-token '8751ad99-2ddb-4aac-ad44-84b21102****' --domain-name example.com --start-time 2018-03-06T19:00:00Z --repeat-num 0 --side-output-url 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea37348366201****?auth_key=1608953344-0-0-53f0758162964516ac850f2ddc3f****' --callback-url 'http://developer.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea37348366201****?auth_key=1608953344-0-0-53f0758162964516ac850f2ddc3f****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCasterEpisodeGroup

fields.help_en:
The URL of the video-on-demand (VOD) file. If you query the video sources of the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848023.html operation, check the value of the VodUrl parameter returned in the response. This parameter is used only when the resource is a video file and the video file is not imported to the media library.
Supported formats include MP4, FLV, and TS
fields.help_zh:
点播文件地址。 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848023.html查询导播台视频源，请查看DescribeCasterVideoResources接口调用返回的参数VodUrl值。 当且仅当资源为文件视频，且视频文件未导入素材库时使用。
支持MP4、FLV、TS格式
fields.name: vod_url

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

<notice> You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。

<notice> 由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
</notice>
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of repetitions. Valid values:
0: The program does not loop.
-1: The program loops infinitely
parameters.help_zh:
重复次数。取值：
0：不循环。
-1：无限循环
parameters.name: repeat_num

parameters.help_en: The custom ingest URL that corresponds to the bypass output URL of the production studio
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义导播台旁路输出地址对应的推流地址
parameters.name: side_output_url

parameters.help_en:
The custom callback URL.

The URL must be a valid URL that complies with the RFC 2396 standard. The host must be a real domain name or IP address that can be resolved by DNS.

If you query the configuration information of the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html operation, check the value of the CallbackUrl parameter returned in the response
parameters.help_zh:
用户回调地址。

必须是符合 RFC 2396 标准的合法 URL，host必须是可被 DNS 解析的真实域名或 IP。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html查询导播台配置信息，请查看DescribeCasterConfig接口调用返回的参数CallbackUrl值
parameters.name: callback_url

ProgramId.description_en: The ID of the program list. You can use this ID as a request parameter to delete the program list of a production studio, create or add a program item, delete a program item, query a program item, edit a program list, delete a program list, query a program list, start a program list, or stop a program list
ProgramId.description_zh: 节目单ID。可作为删除导播台节目列表，创建或添加节目单项，删除节目单项，查询节目单项，编辑节目单，删除节目单，查询节目单，启动节目单，停止节目单的请求参数
